hero.headline: Transparent pricing, scoped to what you need
hero.sub: Price scales with whether we capture content on-site, how complex the site is, and how long the shoot runs. No flat minimum that overcharges simple jobs or undersells bigger ones.
hero.trustLine: Transparent pricing, scoped to what you actually need. No long contracts. Work directly with the person who builds it.

projectTiers.label: One-time projects
projectTiers.intro: Start with the smallest offer that solves the problem. Content capture is the main lever that moves price up.

tiers.name: GBP Content Refresh
tiers.description: No new website. On-site photo, short-form video, and a cleaned-up Google Business Profile so locals see quality now.
tiers.scopeDriver: Entry offer when you need fresh visuals and GBP setup without rebuilding the site.
includes: Google Business Profile optimization (categories, services, photos, posts)

tiers.name: Website Only
tiers.description: A conversion-focused site built and customized on Webflow or Shopify when you already have usable photos and copy.
tiers.scopeDriver: $800–$1,000 for a simple 1–5 page brochure site. $1,200–$1,500 for more pages, Shopify setup, booking or lead forms, or extra revision rounds.
includes: Site built and customized on Webflow or Shopify
Basic SEO foundations and launch support

tiers.name: Website + Content Capture
tiers.description: Website build plus a 2–4 hour on-location photo and video shoot, edited and placed on the site and Google Business Profile.
tiers.scopeDriver: Right fit when the business looks better in person than online and needs both a site and real content in one project.
includes: Half-day on-location photo and video shoot
Edited assets for the site and GBP

tiers.name: Website + Extended Content
tiers.description: Larger site with more pages or stakeholder complexity, plus a full-day content shoot across multiple locations or product lines.
tiers.scopeDriver: For multi-location businesses, ministries, or catalogs that need deeper coverage. Larger church and multi-stakeholder projects land near the top of this range.
includes: Full-day content shoot (multiple locations or products)

ongoingTiers.label: Ongoing
ongoingTiers.intro: Month-to-month retainers for businesses that already have a site and need to stay visually current, or want content plus ads managed together.

tiers.name: Content + Growth Retainer
tiers.description: Ongoing monthly photo and video content, GBP posting, and review management for businesses that already have a site.
tiers.scopeDriver: Scope depends on shoot frequency and how many channels we keep current each month.

tiers.name: Full Growth Partner
tiers.description: Content plus Meta ads management combined. Scoped to your offer, market, and ad budget. No published ceiling.
tiers.scopeDriver: Bespoke. We define deliverables, ad management load, and reporting after a short intake.
includes: GBP and review support as needed

bookCta.headline: Not sure which tier fits?
bookCta.quote: Start with a free Growth Audit. We will map your site, content, and GBP to the right offer.
bookCta.sub: Or jump to the pricing tiers above and pick the scope that matches how much content you need us to capture.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It depends on whether you supply photos and copy or we capture content on-site. Website Only (you supply content) runs $800–$1,500. Website plus a half-day shoot is $2,000–$2,800. Website plus a full-day or multi-location shoot starts at $3,000–$4,500+.

A $400–$600 one-time offer with no new website. We shoot on-site photo and short-form video, optimize your Google Business Profile (categories, services, photos, posts), and set up review generation. Fastest entry point if you need to look better locally without a rebuild.
No. Project work is scoped and billed per engagement. Retainers are month-to-month.

faq.q: How fast can you turn around a site?
faq.a: Simpler builds can turn around in as little as 24–48 hours when content and decisions are ready. Larger sites, multi-stakeholder projects, and shoot-inclusive work take longer. We set a realistic timeline after intake.

faq.q: What changes the price within a tier?
faq.a: Whether we capture content on-site, site complexity (pages, Shopify vs brochure, forms), shoot duration, and number of locations or product lines. Every quote ties price to those levers.

faq.q: Do you build custom code from scratch?
faq.a: Sites are built and customized on Webflow or Shopify, not ground-up custom code frameworks. You get a production site in your account with the structure, design, and integrations scoped for your business.
Pick a tier that matches your scope, or request a free Growth Audit. We review your online presence and recommend the right project or retainer.
